metadata.article_title: After care of children leaving child care institution.

article.title: After care of children leaving child care institution.
article.content: Any child leaving a child care institution on completion of eighteen years of age may be provided with financial support in order to facilitate child’s re-integration into the mainstream of the society in the manner as may be prescribed.
article.html:
46After care of children leaving child care institution.

Section 46 · Chapter VII · page 29 of the Act

Any child leaving a child care institution on completion of eighteen years of age may be provided with financial support in order to facilitate child’s re-integration into the mainstream of the society in the manner as may be prescribed.
